about: PACK T0 deliverable (REALM-MAP-PLAN §5.1.1, confirmed against each kit manifest at fc5c6ad1). Class ids: DEEP 0, SEA 1, WATER 2, SHORE 3, WILD 4, GROUND2 5, FIELD 6, ROCK 7, SNOW 8, SPECIAL 9, ROAD 10, TURF 11, RING 12, FOREST 13. MAP: 'WILD' = drawn as WILD ground under an overlay; M1..M5 = the §5.3 map families (lower = the realm's WILD map terrain for all five, M4 included: a ROCK-lower M4 collapsed where snow/glacier/lava met open ground, PACK 2026-09-24). TRUE: kit terrain ids as in kit.json; names marked extra are ART's TRUE extra terrains (§5.3); 'decals' names a realm-map decal group made only of that kit's own decal ids; 'scatter' names kit props scattered by LIFE. layer = composite order where >= 3 terrains meet (kit terrains keep kit.json's layer). decalByClass: the ONE decal group GROUND applies per class at TRUE (kit layout group id or a realm-map rm_* group); decals only on single-terrain, non-kingdom tiles, the kit's hash rule.
